message.content: {"note_claim": "NASA has a history of airshow participation (and outreach) as part of its mission, including Isaacman flying the F-5 at airshows.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "At the Pacific Airshow in Huntington Beach, California, Oct. 2-4, the agency will showcase fast-flying jets, a real Moon rock from Apollo 15, and a model of the next Mars helicopter, SkyFall.", "reason": "The page shows NASA officially participating in an airshow with Isaacman flying an F-5, but it says nothing about who pays, the Flight Inspiration Program, or a history of X-plane airshow participation."}

parsed.note_claim: NASA has a history of airshow participation (and outreach) as part of its mission, including Isaacman flying the F-5 at airshows.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: At the Pacific Airshow in Huntington Beach, California, Oct. 2-4, the agency will showcase fast-flying jets, a real Moon rock from Apollo 15, and a model of the next Mars helicopter, SkyFall.
